**Root cause:** `src/jobs/processOrder.js` acquired connection, then `await run(...)` — reject skipped `pool.release(conn)`. Every failed job leaked one connection, permanent (pool has no reclaim, per `src/db/pool.js:3-5`). Request path via `withConnection` was fine, so only worker path bled.

**Log evidence:** failing jobs never emit "connection released":
```
01:56:11.740Z ERROR [worker-1] job order-4013 failed: invalid order payload
```
Pool drained job-by-job until `02:11:20.800Z ERROR [worker-2] POST /orders 503 (pool exhausted)`, then stuck — matches your 2am page.

**Fix:** route worker path through same `withConnection` helper (try/finally release). Stale comment about retry loop removed too.

```js
async function processOrder(pool, order, run) {
  return withConnection(pool, (conn) => run(conn, order));
}
```

**Tests:** `node --test tests/pool.test.js` — 4/4 pass.

Note: `node --test tests/` (directory arg) fails with `Cannot find module ...\tests` on your Node v22.22.2 — pre-existing runner/path quirk, not code. Pass file glob or add `tests/**/*.test.js`.
